Plugins_TotalCommander_EnableInlineSearc: Allow double-clicking or pressing hotkeys in Total Commander to summon inline search
Plugins_TotalCommander_EnableQuickNavDes: Allow middle-clicking in Total Commander's file list to summon the Quick Navigation menu
TotalCommander_PluginDesc: Total Commander integration plugin. Reads active paths and provides quick directory jumping in Total Commander.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_TotalCommanderPathColle: Reads and tracks the active panel directories of Total Commander.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_TotalCommanderInlineSea: Provides inline typing filter navigation and directory jumping for Total Commander lister windows.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_DirMenuProvider: Loads and presents Total Commander's directory hotlist (Ctrl+D menu) in the Quick Navigation cascade.
